name: Dominican Republic
legislatureName: National Congress of the Republic (Congreso Nacional de la República)

legislature.party: Modern Revolutionary Party (PRM) and its allies

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

partiesListed.party: Institutional Social Democratic Bloc or BIS
Liberal Reformist Party or PRL (formerly the Liberal Party of the Dominican Republic or PLRD)
Social Christian Reformist Party or PRSC

profile.religions: Evangelical 50.2%, Roman Catholic 30.1%, none 18.5%, unspecified 1.2% (2023 est.)
profile.legalSystem: civil law system based on the French civil code; Criminal Procedures Code modified in 2004 to include important elements of an accusatory system
profile.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory; married persons can vote, regardless of age
profile.location: Caribbean, eastern two-thirds of the island of Hispaniola, between the Caribbean Sea and the North Atlantic Ocean, east of Haiti
